name: Practera Admin
description: CakePHP 2.x monolith serving as the admin interface and legacy API backend. Includes Cutie, a modern Angular/Ionic frontend for program management.

name: Practera App (App V2)
description: Primary learner-facing application. Provides the student experience for experiential learning programs.

name: Practera Login App
description: Vite + React SPA providing the authentication frontend. Handles passwordless login (magic link + passkey), stack switching, LTI deep linking, and admin management.

name: Practera Login API
description: Unified login API handling LTI 1.3, magic link, passkey (WebAuthn), stack switching, and branding. Runs on AWS Lambda.

name: Practera GraphQL API
description: Apollo Server 4 GraphQL API serving the learner app. Connects to PostgreSQL and Redis, proxies to CakePHP for legacy data.

name: Practera Services
description: TypeScript monorepo of AWS Lambda backend services: email (SES), SMS (Twilio), notifications (Soketi/Pusher), AI (Vercel AI SDK), ops workers, statistics, and templates.

name: Practera TUS Upload Service
description: TUS-compatible resumable file upload server with FileStack migration tooling. NX monorepo with Go and Node.js.

name: Practera MCP Server
description: Model Context Protocol server giving AI agents direct access to Practera's GraphQL API and project brief data. Includes CLI tools for designer, PM, and developer personas.

name: Practera Test Suite
description: Master testing suite: load (k6), security (Nuclei/Wfuzz), functional (Newman), integration, and browser (Playwright) tests. Includes CLI runner and React web dashboard.

name: Practera DevOps Center
description: Terminal UI (TUI) application providing a unified control panel for developers and infrastructure admins. Manages local dev stack, cross-repo test orchestration, and production operations.

name: Project Hub
description: Next.js application for sourcing and managing industry projects and project briefs. Used by coordinators to find real-world projects for learner programs.

name: Project Brief AI Generator
description: AI-powered tool for generating industry project briefs for experiential learning programs.
